title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Alakazam Mega Symphonia 038/063 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Pokemon Alakazam #038/063 Japanese Mega Symphonia Holo Rare card is a highly sought-after collectible for fans of the Pokemon Trading Card Game. With a Psychic attribute, high HP of 140, and being part of the M1s set released in 2025, this Stage 2 Pokemon card features stunning artwork by illustrator Bun Toujo. Manufactured by The Pokemon Company in Japan, this holo rare card is a valuable addition to any Pokemon TCG collection, especially for collectors looking for Japanese cards.
